situation: We're a small airport shuttle company. A customer, Ms Alvarez, booked a 5am pickup Saturday, the driver never showed, she missed her flight to Denver and paid $340 to rebook. She's emailed furious. It was our scheduling error.
reply:
Hi Ms Alvarez,
You booked our 5am pickup on Saturday, no driver arrived, and you missed your flight to Denver and had to pay $340 to rebook. That's on us, and I'm sorry. I've refunded your $65 fare today, and I'll reimburse the $340 within two working days of you replying with the rebooking receipt. I'm Kevin, the owner; reply to me directly or call 555-0142.
Kevin
note: Her whole cost is covered, not just the fare, and the internal cause stays out of it.

situation: ネットで服を売っています。セール品のワンピースを買ったお客様が「返品できないなんて詐欺だ」と怒っています。返品不可は商品ページにも注文確認メールにも書いてあります。
reply: 楽しみにしていただいたワンピースが合わず、残念な思いをさせてしまいました。確認したところ、こちらはセール品で、商品ページと9月18日の注文確認メールに「返品不可」と記載しておりました。返金はできかねますが、サイズ交換でしたら送料は当店負担で承ります。ご希望のサイズを返信でお知らせいただけますか。
note: 事実の誤りは、気持ちを受け止めてから証拠で静かに正す。できないことより、できることを具体的に。

situation: 我开外卖店。顾客在平台上骂得很难听，说送到的酸菜鱼是凉的，要全额退款还要赔偿。确实比预计晚送了40分钟。
reply: 您好，您的酸菜鱼晚到了40分钟，送到时已经凉了，这是我们的问题，对不起。这单我现在就全额退款，另外给您发一张30元无门槛券，下次可以用。我想把这件事处理好，也希望我们能好好沟通。后续有任何问题，直接在这里回复我就行，我是店长老周。
note: 对骂人的话不接，只回应事实和补救。如果对方继续辱骂，说明你会解决，但需要保持文明沟通。

situation: I run a small bakery. A customer, Jess, commented on our latest Instagram post that the birthday cake she picked up Saturday said 'Happy Birthday Kayla' instead of 'Kaylee' and her daughter cried. Our order form says Kaylee. The comment has 20 likes.
reply: Jess, we spelled Kaylee's name wrong on her birthday cake, and that's our mistake. I'm so sorry it happened on her day. I'd like to make it right with a fresh cake for Kaylee, on us, any day this week that suits you. I've sent you a DM to sort the details, or you can call me at the shop on 555-0142. Maria, owner
note: Reply in public first so onlookers see it owned, then move the details to DMs. Name the exact mistake rather than 'any inconvenience'.

situation: I run a furniture shop. I already apologised to a customer, Mr Brennan, for his sofa arriving with a torn cushion, and offered a free replacement cushion delivered Friday. He's replied that's not good enough and he wants a full refund AND to keep the sofa, or he'll leave a one-star review.
reply: I hear you, Mr Brennan, and I know a torn cushion on a new sofa is a real letdown. A full refund while keeping the sofa isn't something I can do. What I can do is either the new cushion delivered Friday 2 October plus a $150 refund for the hassle, or collect the sofa and refund you in full. Which would you prefer?
note: Ignore the review threat. Restate the fix, add one proportionate option, and hold the line on the unreasonable demand without matching his tone.

situation: I'm head of support at a payroll software company. A bug in Monday's release meant 40 of a client's staff got paid a day late. Their HR director, Fiona Walsh, emailed our CEO in all caps saying her people couldn't pay rent. It's our fault.
reply:
Hi Fiona,
On Monday 40 of your people were paid a day late because of us, and some of them had to explain that to a landlord. That's ours: a bug in Monday's release stopped the payment file reaching the bank. It's fixed, and every payment landed this morning. We'll cover any late fees or overdraft charges your staff were hit with; they can send receipts straight to me and I'll reimburse within five working days. We're also waiving your October subscription. You'll have the full incident report from me by Friday. My direct line is 0161 496 0142.
Ruth Adeyemi, Head of Support
note: B2B: the real impact is on her employees, so the make-good goes to them first, then to the account. Answer from a named person, not the CEO's inbox.

situation: 我在淘宝开店卖茶叶。一位顾客收到货后发消息骂人，说快递盒被压扁了，两罐茶叶罐都凹了，要给差评。物流记录显示是中转时压坏的，不是我们打包的问题，但她确实是吃亏的那个。
reply: 您好，盒子压扁了，两罐茶叶罐都凹了，好好的东西收到时变成这样，确实让人窝火。物流记录显示是在中转站压坏的，跟快递公司索赔的事我来办，不用您操心。两罐新的我今天就用加厚箱给您重新发，发出后把单号发您；原来那两罐如果茶叶本身没受潮，您留着喝就好。我是店主阿秀，后面有任何问题直接在这里找我。
note: 不是你的错也先接住她的损失，再平静说一次事实，然后把能做的做到位；差评的威胁不用回应。
